main_topics.reason: User came because infliximab stopped working and the consultant said Humira was the only plan; options were discussed across most turns.
User is furious at being brushed off and treated as awkward for asking questions, and returns to wanting to be part of the decision.
User opens furious and later says they feel they have a handle on things instead of just anger.
Bot raised it and user engaged, taking it as something to push back with, but it was one part of the discussion.
User asked directly about a second opinion and worry about going behind the consultant's back over a few turns.
User accepted a list of questions to bring and said they would book the appointment and take it in.

output.summary: User on infliximab for four years, which stopped working, was angry that their consultant decided on a switch to Humira without discussing other options. The bot acknowledged the frustration, explained other biologic classes, suggested asking about drug levels and antibodies, wrote a question list and addressed second opinions on the NHS. User said they now had a plan and would book an appointment and bring the list. No safety-critical moments arose.
